headline: Applications for a 66-unit apartment building at 1052 South Colony Road and a mixed-use development at 900/902/920/940 So. Colony Road.
summary: The agenda lists old business on several development applications, including a parking lot expansion at 358 Hall Avenue and a fence at 23A Country Way. It also includes staff reports and pending violation matters.
